login.title: Who is working?
login.subtitle: Tap your name, then enter your PIN

errors.BAD_REQUEST: Something is missing or wrong. Check the details and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: You are logged out. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the owner.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This was not found. Go back and open it again.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this. The screen is updated, please check and try again.
errors.TABLE_BUSY: This table is already in use. Open its order instead.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: Some food is finished. Remove it and send again.
errors.OVERPAYMENT: Amount is more than the bill. Enter a smaller amount.
errors.LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: The screen is old. Go back and open it again.
errors.UNPROCESSABLE: This cannot be done right now. Check and try again.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: Not saved, try again. If it repeats, call the owner.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The counter computer is starting. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.NETWORK: No connection to the counter computer. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
